claims: C1 following the initial release of the Model Spec in May 2024, many users and developers expressed support for enabling a grown-up mode -- a historical fact about feedback received, with no bearer and no act

C2 OpenAI is EXPLORING HOW TO let developers and users generate erotica and gore in age-appropriate contexts through the API and ChatGPT so long as usage policies are met -- the main verb is exploring, so the relaxation is a matter under investigation and is not put into effect by this span
C3 sexual deepfakes and revenge porn are named as potentially harmful uses against which OpenAI draws a hard line, i.e. they lie outside whatever relaxation is being explored
C4 the span states no obligation, prohibition, permission or preference borne by the assistant: the subject of every main verb is We (OpenAI) or many users and developers
